snippet.title: Monster Chef | Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
➤ Play Monster Chef Demo on Steam NOW! http://s.team/a/3721600 

Monster Chef is a hand-drawn roguelite action RPG featuring hack & slash gameplay by day and restaurant management by night. 

Discover a unique combat system where you turn fearsome monsters into delicious dishes, rebuild your inn and uncover the secrets of the lands of Delizia. 

Wishlist and play the demo NOW! http://s.team/a/3721600 

Monster Chef is an indie game developed by Studio Pizza - https://www.studiopizza.net/
